ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how disbelievers will be bound in the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this imperative command from Allah to the angels highlights the immediate and forceful nature of seizing the disbelievers, contrasting with the earlier command to seize the righteous. The term 'ghullū' (bind them) specifically refers to chaining the hands to the neck, symbolizing the humiliation and inescapability of their punishment for rejecting the truth. This verse serves as a direct consequence to the denial of the Hereafter, emphasizing divine justice in the final reckoning.
